verses.en: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
verses.sm: Papelonia Ua uma ona ati o le pa, ua faatuina foi puipui, ua tofia foi leoleo faitotoa, ma e pepese, ma sa Levi, ona ou tuuina atu lea ia Hanani lo'u uso,

verses.en: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.
verses.sm: ma Hanania le alii e pule i le ‘olo, e pule i Ierusalema; aua o le tagata faamaoni ia, ua sili foi lona mata‘u i le Atua i lo le toatele.

verses.en: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.
verses.sm: Ua ou fai atu foi ia te i laua, Aua neʻi tatalaina faitotoa O Ierusalema seia vevela le la; ia latou puipui foi i faitotoa ma faamau ai o la o tutu ai, ma ia tofia leoleo o .e nonofo i Ierusalema, taitoastasi i lona leoleoga, taitoatasi foi i lona lumffale.

verses.en: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.
verses.sm: Ua valavala foi le aai ma le lautele; a ua toaitiiti tagata e i ai, e lei faia foi fale. A

verses.en: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,
verses.sm: Ma tuuina mai e lo'u Atua i loʻu loto e faapotopoto i alii, ma faipule, ma le nuu, ina ia tusiga705 faina i latou e tusa ma o latou tupuga. Na ou maua foi le tusi o gafa o e na o ae i le amataga, ona ou iloa lea o loo tusia i ai, ua faapea,

verses.en: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.sm: O i latou nei o tazata o le itu malo nao ae ai le tafeaga, o le tafeaga lea na avea e Nepukanesa le tupu o Papelonia, na latou toe foi mai foi i Ierusalema ma Iuta, taitasi i lona aai;

verses.en: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;
verses.sm: 0 e na o mai ma Serupapelu; o Iosua, o Neemia, o Aseraia, o Raamia, o Naamani, o Moretekai, o Pilesana, o Mesepara, o Pikevai, o Nekuma, o Paana. O le faitau aofai o tagata o le nuu o Isaraelu;

verses.en: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Parose, e lua afe e toaselau e toafitugafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Sefatia, e tolu selau e toafitugafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Araka, e ono selau e toalimagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pakamoapi, O le fanauga ia a losua ma loapo, e lua afe e valu selau ma le toasefulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Elama, e tasi le afe e lua selau ma le toalimagafulu ma le toafa.

verses.en: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Satu, e valu selau e toafagafulu ma le toalima.

verses.en: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Sakai, e fitu selau ma le toaonogafulu.

verses.en: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Penui, e ono selau e toafagafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pepai, e ono selau e toaluafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Asekata, e lua afe e tolu selau e toaluafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Atonikama, e ono selau e toaonogafulu ma le toafitu.

verses.en: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pikevai, e lua afe e toaonogafulu ma le toafitu.

verses.en: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Atini, e ono selau e toalimagafulu ma le toalima.

verses.en: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Atere, mai ia Esekia, e toaivagafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Hasumu, e tolu selau e toaluafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pesai, e tolu selau e toaluafulu ma le toafa.

verses.en: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Haripa, e tasi le selau e toasefulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.
verses.sm: O tagata o Kipeona, e toaivagafulu ma le toalima.

verses.en: The men of Beth-lehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.sm: O tagata o Peteleema ma Netopa, e tasi le selau e toavalugafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
verses.sm: O tagata o Anatota, e tasi le selau e toaluafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty and two.
verses.sm: O tagata o Peteasemau, e toafagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.
verses.sm: O tagata o Kiriata-iarima, O Kafira, ma Perota, e fitu selau e toafagafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.
verses.sm: O tagata o Rama ma Kipea, e ono selau e toaluafulu ma le toatasi.

verses.en: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.
verses.sm: O tagata o Mekemase, e tasi le selau ma le toaluafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The men of Beth-el and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.
verses.sm: O tagata o Peteli ma Ai, e tasi le selau e toaluafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.
verses.sm: O tagata o le tasi Nepo, e toalimagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a le tasi Elama, e tasi le afe e lua selau e toalimagafulu ma le toafa.

verses.en: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Harima, e tolu selau ma le toaluafulu.

verses.en: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
verses.sm: O tagata o leriko, e tolu selau e fagafulu ma le toalima.

verses.en: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.
verses.sm: O tagata o Loto, o Hatito, ma Ono, e fitu selau e toaluafulu ma le toatasi.

verses.en: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
verses.sm: O tagata o Senaa, e tolu afe e iva selau ma le toatolugafulu.

verses.en: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
verses.sm: O le au faitaulaga; o le fanauga a letaia o le aiga o Iosua, e iva selau e toafitugafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Imere, o le fanauga a Parekusa, o le fae tasi le afe e toalimagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pasura, e tasi le afe e lua selau e fagafulu ma le toafitu.

verses.en: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Harima, e tasi le afe e toasefulu ma le toafitu.

verses.en: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.
verses.sm: O sa Levi; o le fanauga a losua, ma Katameeli, o le fanauga ia a Hotavia, e toafitugafulu ma le toafa.

verses.en: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.
verses.sm: O e pepese; o le fanauga a Asafo, e tasi le selau e fagafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.
verses.sm: O leoleo faitotoa; o le fanauga a Saluma, o le fanauga a Atere, o le fanauga a Talemoni, o le fanauga a Akupa, o le fanauga a Hatita, o le fanauga a Sopai, e tasi le selau e toatolugafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
verses.sm: O le au netini; o le fanauga a Seka, o le fanauga a Hasufi, o le fanauga a Tapaota,

verses.en: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Kirosa, o le fanauga a Seaa, o le fanauga a Patono,

verses.en: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Lepana, o le fanauga a Hakepa, O le fanauga a Salemai,

verses.en: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Hanana, o le fanauga a Kitele, o le fanauga a Gakara,

verses.en: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Reaia, o le fanauga a Resina, o le fanauga a Nekota,

verses.en: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Gasama, o le fanauga a Usa, o le fanauga a Pasea,

verses.en: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Pesai, o le fanauga a Meunima, o le fanauga a Nefasemo,

verses.en: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Pakepuka, o le fanauga a Hakupa, o le fanauga a Harekuru,

verses.en: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Paselita, o le fanauga a Mekita, o le fanauga a Haresa,

verses.en: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,
verses.sm: nauga a Sesera, o le fanauga a Timaka,

verses.en: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Neseka,, o le fanauga a Hatifa.

verses.en: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
verses.sm: O le fanauga a auauna a Solomona; o le fanauga a Sotai, o le fanauga a Soferete, o le fanauga a Feruta,

verses.en: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a laala, o le fanauga a Tarekono, o le fanauga a Kitele,

verses.en: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Sefatia, o le fanauga a Hatili, o le fanauga a Pokerete o le Sepaima, o le fanauga a Amoni.

verses.en: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
verses.sm: O le au netini uma, ma le fanauga a auauna a Solomona, e tolu selau e toaivagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: And these were they which went up also from Tel-melah, Tel-haresha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.
verses.sm: O i latou nei na o ae ai Telemelaka, ma Tele-aresa, ma Kirova, ma Atana, ma Imere; a ua latou le mafaia ona faailoa mai le aiga o latou tama, ma lo latou tupuga, pe ni Isaraelu i latou.

verses.en: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Talaia, o le fanauga a Tovia, o le fanauga a Nekota, e ono selau e toafagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
verses.sm: O le au faitaulaga foi; o le fanauga a Hapaia, o le fanauga a Kosa, o le fanauga a Pasili, o le na fai aua i le tasi afafine o Pasili le Kiliata, sa igoa foi o ia i lo latou igoa.

verses.en: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.sm: O i latou ia na sailiili i o latou tusi gafa na tusia ai o latou gafa, a e lei maua, sa taʻua ai i latou ua leaga, ua te'a ai ma le faiva o faitaulaga.

verses.en: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi ia te i latou le alii e pule, aua neʻi latou aai i mea e sili ona paia, seia tu mai se faitaulaga ma le Urima ma le Tumema.

verses.en: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.sm: O le aofai o le faapotopotoga uma, e fagafulu o afe ma afe e lua ma le tolu selau ma le toaonogafulu;

verses.en: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
verses.sm: a o a latou auauna tane ma a latou auauna fafine, e fitu afe e tolu selau e toatolugafulu ma le toafitu o i latou; sa ia te i latou foi O tane pepese ma fafine pepese, e lua selau ma le toafagafulu ma le toalima.

verses.en: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
verses.sm: O a latou solofanua, e fitu selau e tolugafulu ma le ono; o a latou falata, e lua selau e fagafulu ma le lima;

verses.en: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.
verses.sm: o kamela, e fa selau ma le tolugafulu ma le lima; o asini e ono afe e fitu selau ma le luafulu.

verses.en: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests' garments.
verses.sm: O isi foi o matai sili, ua latou foaiina atu i le galuega. Ua foaiina atu i le oloa e le alii e pule o tareki o auro e tasi le afe, o ipu e limagafulu, o ofu tino o faitaulaga e lima selau ma le tolugafulu.

verses.en: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.
verses.sm: O isi foi matai sili, ua latou foaiina atu i le oloa mo le galuega, o tareki o auro e luafulu o afe, ma mina a ario e lua afe ma le lua o selau.

verses.en: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.
verses.sm: O mea foi na foaiina atu e i latou ua totoe o le nuu, o tareki o auro e luafulu o afe, ma mina o ario e lua afe, ma ofu tino o faitaulaga e onogafulu ma le fitu.

verses.en: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.
verses.sm: Sa nonofo foi i a latou aai o faitaulaga, ma sa Levi, ma leoleo faitotoa, ma e pepese, O isi foi o le nuu, ma le au netini, ma Isaraelu uma; ua oo foi i le fitu o masina ua i a latou aai le fanauga a Isaraelu. O le faitauina o le tulafono.
